description: Generate a D&D loot using the declared prompt and optional structured fields. Entity text is free on every user plan, including Free. This generator does not create a portrait. Partner keys are billed from their wallet. Returns a job_id immediately; poll chargen_get_job for the entity_id and page_url. Pass collection_id to file it into your folder. Generated entries are public by default; change visibility in CharGen. User accounts only.

collection_id.description: Optional folder UUID owned by you; user accounts only. The finished entity is filed there on the first completed chargen_get_job poll.

idempotency_key.description: Optional partner billing deduplication key. Retries with the same key avoid a second wallet debit, but can start another generation.

protection.description: AUTO, NONE, LOCKED, TRAPPED or LOCKED_TRAPPED

theme.description: the prompt is used when this is omitted

name: chargen_generate_loot
title: Generate loot
